name: Prime LC cascade transmission S21 = zeta(2s)/zeta(s)
statement: For sections T_p=[[1,a],[a,1]], a=p^{-s}: S11=0 identically, S21=S12=2/Sigma_+ with prod_p(1+p^{-s})=zeta(s)/zeta(2s) for Re s>1; by continuation S21 is proportional to zeta(2s)/zeta(s). Zeta zeros are poles of S21, not zeros of any S-parameter; det S vanishes where zeta(2s)=0.

name: Euler product as lossless sections converges only for Re s>1
statement: The cascade identity S21*zeta=const is established from the Euler product on Re s>1 and extended by the identity theorem; no passivity or contractivity statement of the infinite cascade transfers into the strip. Obstruction map row G10 (and Q10: chain is l^1 only on Re s>1).

name: Winding of the bridge chi(1/2+it) equals N(T)
statement: The winding number of the bridge function along the critical line from 0 to T equals the zero count N(T) (Riemann-von Mangoldt); the phase around one zero is +-2pi; under s->1-s on-line zeros are self-partnered, off-line zeros are swapped in pairs (Z/2 invariant). Checked at T=10..1000.

name: Functional equation plus unitarity cannot exclude asymmetric zero pairs
statement: Quartets {1/2+-eps+-i gamma} are consistent with the functional equation, bridge unitarity and reflection positivity |xi|^2>=0; excluding them needs Weil positivity, which is RH. Spectral positivity presupposes real zeros.

name: Kronecker flow on T^inf has spectrum unrelated to zeta zeros
statement: The generator d/dt of the flow on T^inf=prod_p S^1_{log p} is self-adjoint with eigenvalues 2pi sum n_k/log p_k, dense in R (Kronecker-Weyl); they do not match zeta zeros. Under integer indexing of Fourier modes the regularised spectral zeta is sum m^{-s}=zeta(s).

name: Turan partial sums S_N(s) have off-line zeros (Montgomery 1983)
statement: S_50(s)=sum_{n<=50} n^{-s} has 33 near-zeros (|S|<0.3) with sigma in [0.5,0.9], t in [10,50]; Montgomery: S_N has zeros with sigma>1-c/log N for some N. Finite Dirichlet truncations cannot prove RH without the functional equation.

name: Finite Weil-Li Gram matrix M_N is nearly rank one and blind to off-line zeros
statement: M_N built from v_gamma=(2 sin(k theta/2))_k, theta=atan2(gamma,gamma^2-1/4)~1/gamma: PSD for N<=100, max eigenvalue ~N^2.72, effective rank 1..4. Injecting 200 off-line zeros at beta=0.9 leaves M_30 PSD. Content of RH lives only as N->infinity.

name: All four mapped proof paths end at a positivity statement
statement: Dependency graph over 270 modules, 6 layers: Hilbert-Polya (self-adjoint extension), Weil positivity, de Branges/Hermite-Biehler, Beurling-Nyman each reduce to one positivity statement equivalent to RH; 13 surveyed strategies share it.

name: Lambda bound gives region sigma>1/2+L*log(|t|/2pi)-type strip, no converse
statement: A bound Lambda<=L confines zeros of H_0 to a height-dependent strip; at gamma=3e12 the effective constant is R_eff~0.649 versus R=5.573 classical, crossover near 7e13. Information flows from half-plane to Lambda (Lambda<=2d^2), never back.

name: Deterministic Koksma-Hlawka bound for the Dyson-Burgers intercept
statement: ||m_N-m_inf||_inf <= pi*C_Selberg*log(gamma_N)/(N*y), using V_R(1/(gamma-z))=pi/y and the S(T) discrepancy; gives lim sup |t_c(N)|=0 for the first-collision time of the backward Calogero-Moser/Dyson flow on the first N zeros. A particle-flow statement, not a Lambda bound.

name: Backward Dyson ODE collision time versus N
statement: Measured first-collision time |t_c(N)| for N up to 1e6 Odlyzko zeros fits a+b/N (early fit 0.011+5.49/N); pair-ODE t_c=d_min^2/8 (1.776e-4 at N=1e4) agrees with the full flow. Upper bounds on t_c point the wrong way for Lambda<=-t_c+E(N).

name: Conjecture 15.2/15.3: shift-bridge positivity K_a>=0
statement: |X(w-a)|<|X(w+a)| for Re w>0, X(w)=xi(1/2+w); equivalently E_a(z)=xi(1/2+a-iz) is Hermite-Biehler and the shifted de Branges kernel K_a is positive definite for every a>0. Equivalent to RH (de Branges 1968, Lagarias 2007).

name: Conjecture 18.2 prime-delay domination: test stops at Re w=1/2
statement: Re xi'/xi(1/2+w)>0 computed from primes p^m<=1e4 plus archimedean drift: holds at 12 points with Re w>1/2 (min margin 0.022); the 16 points with Re w<=1/2 are inconclusive because the truncated echo train sum Lambda(n)n^{-s} diverges.

name: Volterra bound ||V_{a,Phi}||<=1 (collapse of paper sections 15-27)
statement: Block positivity [[I,V],[V#,I]]>=0 iff ||V||<=1 (Schur complement); seven paper conjectures reduce to it. HS bound sqrt(I_0 J_a) holds for zeta, Dirichlet L mod 3,5,7,11 (margins 1.72-2.59) and five imaginary quadratic Dedekind zetas (1.52-1.55). No Euler-product input; DH kernel also passes.

name: Diagonal measure fails to dominate the shear on 64% of tau; cosh completion covers it
statement: At the genuine Riemann Phi, mu_diag does not dominate the shear nu on about 64% of the tau range (degree-0 measure). Endpoint-bridge weight w(tau)=cosh(a tau) gives residual deficit exactly 0; B/D(s)=(sinh s-s)/(cosh s-s+arcsinh1-sqrt2), s=aU; one operator obstruction remains.

name: Antisymmetric shear Gram is exactly rank 2
statement: i*G_shear has spectrum {+mu,-mu,0,...} with mu=sqrt(|p|^2|q|^2-<p,q>^2), so min eig=-||G_shear||; independent of the (a,U) cell and verified against a dense eigensolve.

name: Beurling-Nyman density criterion: strict equivalence, no quantitative lever
statement: Nyman 1950, Beurling 1955, Bercovici-Foias, BBLS-05 are RH equivalences; the Baez-Duarte constant is a zero-side moment. Reweighting d_N by any multiplier class (polynomial, sparse, lacunary, compact Mellin support) leaves admissible band s<1/2 disjoint from the sensitive band s~1.

name: Hecke triangle groups: zeta detection and non-arithmetic statistics exclude each other
statement: Zeta enters a Selberg trace formula only through the Eisenstein scattering determinant of an arithmetic group; among Hecke triangle groups G_q only arithmetic ones (Takeuchi 1977) carry it, and those have arithmetic (non-GUE) spectral statistics. No 2-point bound at support >1 follows.

name: Direct construction of H(E_a) from Phi splits into a formal layer and an RH-equivalent positivity layer
statement: Aronszajn RKHS factorisation plus Arov-Nudelman passive realisation build the space unconditionally and independently of zero location; the remaining layer is E_a Hermite-Biehler, equivalent to RH.

name: Levinson-Conrey mollified moments cannot confine zeros to a strip
statement: Proportion records (1/3, 2/5, 0.4105, 0.4128, 5/12) count zeros on the line by a mean-value argument tied to the line by symmetry; confining a proportion to |sigma-1/2|<eps needs zero density. No Lambda bound follows.

name: Twin-ladder phase tomography carries no information beyond Hardy Z
statement: Reality of Z(t)=e^{i theta(t)}zeta(1/2+it) forces theta(t)+arg zeta(1/2+it)=0 mod pi, so the tomographic phase observable is determined by S(T); the ladder axis is transverse to Lambda.

name: Backlund argument-principle rectangle counts zeros without locating them
statement: N_R=(1/2pi) change of arg zeta around a rectangle straddling the line (Backlund 1918, Trudgian 2014) gives counts; explicit S(T) bounds on sigma=1/2 give no independent constraint on Lambda and continuation off the line is RH-gated.

name: Connes-Consani scaling site: positivity on the square remains RH-equivalent
statement: The 2016-2019 arithmetic/scaling site and its Riemann-Roch advance the geometric layer (curve analogue) but the Hodge-type positivity on the square is equivalent to RH; no 2-point bound at support >1.

name: Random multiplicative model results do not derandomise to zeta
statement: Harper 2017 statements for random multiplicative functions use independence across primes of random phases; no mechanism transfers them to the deterministic sequence p^{-it}.

name: Robin margin along colossally abundant numbers is Mertens-governed
statement: e^gamma - sigma(N)/(N log log N) along 300 colossally abundant N: growth rate set by Mertens product error; carries no de Bruijn-Newman content.

name: Negative index ind_-(K_a)=0 on window grid; off-line controls give 1,2,3
statement: Pontryagin negative index of K_a tracked as an argument-principle winding for a in (0,5) is 0 on all windows; the absolute Birman-Krein spectral shift of the twin-ladder operator reproduces 0 without reference subtraction, and planted off-line pairs give index 1,2,3.

name: Li coefficients lambda_n, n<=300, from 1e6 zeros
statement: lambda_n=sum_rho[1-(1-1/rho)^n] computed by the Bombieri-Lagarias zero sum over 1e6 Odlyzko ordinates; all positive. Positivity for n up to ~H^2 log H is a function of verified height H.

name: Route A: |R_a(w)|<1 on Re w>0 by maximum principle
statement: R_a(w)=X(w-a)/X(w+a), X(w)=xi(1/2+w). |R_a(it)|=1 exactly (X even, real on R). Phragmen-Lindelof would give |R_a|<=1 inside if R_a were analytic there, i.e. if X(w+a) had no zeros in Re w>0: the single circular gap.

name: Pair correlation of first 1e4 unfolded zeros versus sine kernel
statement: R_2(x) versus 1-(sin pi x/pi x)^2 on x in [0.1,3]: L-inf deviation 0.0640 at x=0.43, L2 0.0281, localised on the flank of the repulsion dip.

name: Twin-ladder kernel as resolvent of a canonical system; explicit Hamiltonian for finite surrogate
statement: Under RH the Weyl m-function is Nevanlinna, so a unique trace-normed H(x) exists (de Branges). For the finite point-measure surrogate: Jacobi system with a_k=0 (Lanczos), equivalently a chain of 11 indivisible rank-one intervals (tr H=1, det H=0), reproducing m to 1e-15. Off-line finite-kappa structure open.

name: Random-prime null model violates Weil positivity in 53-66% of trials
statement: Cramer random primes reproduce the mean of the Lambda-weighted prime sum (z-score 0.005-0.236) but W=C-P>=0 fails in 53-66% of 30000 trials, while true primes give W>=0. The bound depends on exact cancellation, not prime density.

name: ESY variance gap closes only with full form-factor support
statement: N-independent residual 2.153e-3 in the variance: widening the Fourier band W leaves residual ~exp(-4 pi W) (4.38e-5 at W=1); strict closure needs full support (Bogomolny-Keating); 4-point input reduces it by zero. All live ESY routes need Montgomery pair correlation.

name: Weil Gram margin on bump bases sinks to the conditioning floor
statement: Diagonal-normalised lambda_min of the Riemann-Weil Gram form: no negative eigenvalue for even dimension K=6..16, support 2.1..4.9, odd K=6..12; odd-block margin falls 7e-10 to 2e-12 with K, at the basis conditioning floor.

name: Volterra norm along the de Bruijn flow tracks kernel scale only
statement: With |Phi_t|_2 normalised to remove the exp(t u^2) scale, the Volterra norm sweep shows no residual zero-location signal, including on the t<0 side where the conclusion is false.

name: Winding of arg H_tau is monotone in heat time (de Bruijn Thm 13 with jet lemma)
statement: The count of real zeros of H_tau in a window is non-decreasing forward in tau; the Gaussian-convolution proxy used earlier equals the exact de Bruijn flow at negative time t=-4 tau. Classical; thread ceiling does not beat Lambda<=0.2.

name: Theta-trap for the Calogero-Moser collision time
statement: Corollary A1: t_c<=g_min(0)^2/6 (2.369e-4 at N=1e4, Theta(0)=0.0017); sharp threshold Theta_b=(sqrt73-5)/8=0.443; regime separation rho*=2/3; lattice cap Theta_K=K/(K+1) attained by the uniform lattice.

name: Global asymmetric isolation constant c_glob
statement: First rigorous lower bound c_glob>=0.8656641635 against ceiling c_half=0.89802; later closed: c_glob=c_half=0.8980208880762339, root of 4+4r-4/r-4/(r+1)-2[psi(1+2/r)-psi(1+1/r)].

name: Gap-domination bootstrap enclosure of the true-flow collision time
statement: H^2/8<=t_c(N)<=H^2/(8 theta) per plateau from initial gap data; certifies K_paper(N)<=2.4238e-6 on N in [1e4,1e6]. The eps'-field version gives an N-uniform transfer modulus in the vector-field error channel (dW/d eps'=3H^4/64), no Gronwall.

name: Realness of the omitted-zero field error without a critical-line assumption
statement: The field error e_k from zeros omitted above the table is real using conjugate closure at every t, projection domination and straddle exclusion; off-line tail above verified height <6e-12. Refereed sound with gaps fixed.

name: Conjecture 22.1: frozen-ladder coefficient-dimension obstruction
statement: A frozen-ladder proxy e^{-alpha u^2} x even polynomial with D_t coefficients has at most 2D_t-2 real zeros, so matching the zero count at the Platt-Trudgian height forces D>=6.18e12. A cost statement; strong global reading falsified.

name: Collision share sigma(N)=E_coll/E(N) is degree-0 homogeneous
statement: E(N)=E_trunc+E_flow+E_coll; crossover E_coll=E_trunc at N~3.280294e9; far-tail local exponent of sigma tends to -1/2 with gap ~1/(2 log T0); crossing elasticities satisfy E_CC+E_ET+E_CF=0. Bookkeeping of the Polymath15-type bridge constants.

name: C_H=C_shock*C_Lip/4: the Lipschitz factor is not N-uniform in the W_1 channel
statement: C_shock(N)=sqrt(2/(3 log gamma_N))<1/3 is closed form; the W_1 Lipschitz modulus C_Theta grows about linearly in N and blows up off-basin like 1/g0. The finite-N Lambda estimate is gated on this constant.

name: Certified argument-principle winding barrier on R=[T_PT,T_PT+Delta]x[-h,h]
statement: Reading the off-line contribution above T_PT=3e12 as exactly zero needs a finite winding count of H_t on a rectangle, a lower bound on inf|H_t'| on long edges and directed-rounding sums; mesh cost and working digits tabulated. Equivalent to more verified height.

name: Lean: packet estimate to de Bruijn chain with (H6) discharged by the argument principle
statement: In the section 4.7 chain, wind(H_t0/B_t0)=0 implies no zeros in the region, given B_t0 nonvanishing (side condition surfaced). Kernel-checked in the Aristotle project.

name: Twistor framework Lemma 6.1 (heat compatibility on range)
statement: If R A=A R, I_K F_+=F_- R and Ahat_pm F_pm=F_pm A then I_K Ahat_+=Ahat_- I_K on ran(F_+); five-step diagram chase, checked on a finite-rank surrogate.

name: Signed shift constant equals a Nevanlinna-Pick interpolant norm
statement: For data w_i=e^{-d nu_i} the half-plane Nevanlinna-Pick matrix is entrywise the seam pencil rho^2 G-DGD; the signed shift constant Lambda(P,d) equals the squared minimal H-inf interpolant norm. Exact N=2 closed form and coalescence law.

name: Theorem RATE-MONO for the two-rate signed constant
statement: Lambda_2(x,r) is strictly decreasing in the rate ratio r on (1,inf) for every x=nu_1 d>0, from the coalescence cap (r->1+) to the single-rate floor e^{-2x} (r->inf).

name: m-uniform Riesz lower bound for the seam Gram on the octave twin lattice
statement: The normalised seam Gram (entries sech of half the log-ratio) is block Toeplitz in the octave index; Grenander-Szego bounds lambda_min by the symbol infimum uniformly in the number m of octaves. The twin-pair symbol does not port off-lattice (onset gap 4.611560 depth units).

name: Confluent Laguerre floor for the coalescent signed constant
statement: Lambda_conf >= e^{-2x} sum_{k<N}(L_k(2x)-L_{k-1}(2x))^2, the exact Rayleigh value of the top Laguerre mode L_{N-1}(2 nu t)e^{-nu t} (Parseval plus a Laguerre translation identity); two-sided leading order proved.

name: Theorem TILT-DET: tilted Cauchy-determinant majorant
statement: For a finite rate set P, depth d and tilt 0<s<min P: Lambda(P,d)<=e^{-2sd} prod_{i,j}(p_i+p_j)/(p_i+p_j-2s); all separation factors cancel, so the bound is uniform under coalescence.

name: Mean-time compression: eigenfunctions change sign near 0; no Perron route
statement: mu_max(P)<x_max(L_K)/(2 min P) strictly for all distinct rates; on the twin lattice 5.0936<mu_inf<=84/11. The spectrum of the mean-time compression M is the solvability set of a lattice log-derivative interpolation problem and every eigenfunction changes sign in every neighbourhood of t=0.

name: Theorem P-POS: positivity of the theta exit density
statement: p(t)>0 on (0,inf) with explicit two-sided enclosures, via the modular dual identity derived by Poisson summation on x e^{-pi^2 t x^2}e^{i pi x} and strict monotonicity; replaces a Brownian exit-time citation. BigInt-verified.

name: Phase-blind no-go for the Lambda<=0.14 family |C_E,17|<R_ex
statement: Five-shell orthogonality plus reproducing kernel gives at best rho_RSS=sqrt(sum|z_g|^2)>=m/sqrt(n); at shell mass m=0.919 the floor 0.41099 exceeds R_ex=0.27969 for every mass distribution. Any phase-blind bound fails; signs of the alias amplitudes are needed.

name: Theorem PICK-WEIL: Weil form on exponentials is a Caratheodory-Pick matrix
statement: On span{e^{-nu t}1_{t>0}}, nu>1/2, the Weil form equals [(xi'/xi(s_i)+xi'/xi(s_j))/(s_i+s_j-1)], s=1/2+nu; the prime side is (Z_i+Z_j)G_ij with Z=-zeta'/zeta(s), not a free signed lattice sum. Checked with 869 zeros (tail 7e-7).

name: ell^2 collapse over 25 sieving primes is over budget
statement: With perfect cross-prime orthogonality the majorant contract needs R_ex>=Q*sqrt(sum_{p<=97} Sbar_p), and sqrt(sum Sbar_p)=1.867 forces Q_target=0.150; stated as an unconditional over-budget result.

name: Mean-square to pointwise transfer constant cancels the saving
statement: The L2->Linf transfer over a window of length H costs sqrt(H), cancelling a mean-square saving H^{-1/2} exactly (Kronecker-sharp). A partial saving H^{-theta} clears the p=97 contract iff theta>=log(1.306)/log H~0.0148 (H~6.7e7). Closing the gap needs arithmetic input.

name: Vinogradov-Korobov region overtakes the classical one only at log t~10242
statement: With Ford-type VK constants the VK zero-free width exceeds the classical (MTY R=5.558691) width from log t=10242.24; the working window top is log t=37.48. The classical region is the operative unconditional one at every reachable height.

name: Certifying inf over the Bohr torus of |B|-gamma|A| on the Lambda=0.145 line
statement: A scan over 55,874 prime phases reports sign information only; the two verdict signs need opposite certificates (a found negative point is one-sided; a positive infimum needs a cover of T^inf). No certified torus obstruction yet.

name: Route A: primon reflection Gram about sigma=1/2 is not PSD
statement: G_ij=(p_i p_j)^{-1/2}exp(-c(log p_i+log p_j)^2) from Gaussian-windowed critical-line pairing of f_i=p_i^{-s}: indefinite from N=4. The Gaussian-damped off-line detector decays like e^{-t gamma^2}, reaching the noise floor at gamma~5.6/sqrt(t).

name: Route C: signed superpositions of L(s,chi) mod 5 have off-line zeros
statement: F=sum eps_k L(s,chi_k), q=5: the FE-pinned sign vector reconstructs Davenport-Heilbronn, with 8 off-line zeros (4 mirrored pairs) in [0.05,1.3]x[0.5,200]; the union of arms has 0. No sign design gives an off-line lower bound.

name: Route E: primon-gas response functions peak at sigma=1, not 1/2
statement: With Z(sigma)=prod_p(1-p^{-sigma})^{-1} as a Bose partition function, susceptibilities peak at the condensation (Hagedorn) edge sigma=1; the strip is inaccessible to the thermodynamic reading.

name: Route B: mean-field pencil keeps 50 real zeros on tau in (-0.56,1.22)
statement: Xi_tau=(1-tau)Xi+2 tau Psi_1 on [10,145]: all 50 zeros real for tau in about (-0.56,1.22); first loss of real-rootedness lies outside [0,1] on both sides.

name: Route B/D: on-line signed-force feasibility margin flattens to a positive floor
statement: Gordan system g_k.w>0, g_k=sign(Z'')(x*)a(x*) at near-collision extrema: margin rho(32,T) measured to gamma_8000 decays then flattens at a positive value; the obstruction to uniformity in T is off the line (Weil strength).

name: Route M: Baez-Duarte/Vasyunin Gram with Bettin-Conrey reciprocity
statement: Nyman-Beurling Gram entries are Vasyunin cotangent sums c_0(h/k) obeying Bettin-Conrey reciprocity; the modular input is the functional equation in Estermann form, not external arithmetic. The route reduces to the Mobius mollifier and Weil positivity. Burnol ratio d_N^2 log N/C does not tighten to N=2000.

name: First moment F(b)>=kappa phi(b) b of Vasyunin sums
statement: Cauchy-Schwarz Q(b)>=F(b)^2/S(b) reduces the mean-square lower companion to F(b)>=kappa phi(b)b; kappa~0.696 measured over 28 moduli up to 30030 (later K=0.6954960511). Gives Int(N)>=(36 kappa^2/pi^2)log N. Sign of the cotangent leaf F_cot(b)>0 iff S(b)<0, not proved.

name: E1(b)=mu(b) b/4+Delta(b) and the b/4 ceiling
statement: Delta(b)=sum_{d|b,d<b}mu(d)d g(b/d), g(m)=ln A+(1/12)log m+R(m) (Glaisher-Kinkelin remainder). |E1(b)|<=b/4 proved for omega(b)=2,3 (sign Delta(pqr)>0 by matched divisors). Full multiplicative monotonicity (MCM) is refuted at omega=11; bracket limit B_inf=ln A+gamma/12=0.2968557824.

name: Small-a intercept of I(a,b)=(a/2)log b+d_a
statement: Measured over a=1..47: d_a=(a/2)(2C+1-log a) in closed form, not a V(b,a)-residue arithmetic function; sub-leading Vasyunin cotangent coefficient -pi/36 confirmed by digamma/Hurwitz check.

name: lam_max of the Vasyunin Gram and Frobenius majorant ladder
statement: Exact ||G_N||_F ladder N=250..16000 with gcd factorisation; Wolkowicz-Styan two-moment bound on lam_max(G_N); log slope of lam_max revises down with N (campaign later proved lam_max<=18). Oscillatory remainder of the Burnol ratio has fitted frequency 3.85.

name: Route H: semilocal S={inf,2} Sonine trace identity is exact but not gap-free
statement: Tr(Q_S theta(g)Q_S)=W_inf(g)+W_2(g)+poles with Q_S=Q_inf x Q_2 holds, but p=2 contributes a sign-indefinite rank-limited shift helping only the odd sector; proven positivity does not extend past support u=ln 2. Non-Sonine pole-term bridges fail by the same p=2 resonance.

name: Route J: pure Fejer scheme floor R>=5.8284
statement: For nonnegative cosine polynomials with a_1/a_0=2cos(pi/(n+2)): c_ceil=2(1-(a_1/a_0)^{-1/2})^2, R_floor=1/c_ceil->5.8284=3+2sqrt2; classical 3-4-1 gives R~34.82. Mossinghoff-Trudgian 5.573 lies below the pure-scheme floor by using extra inputs. Shape c/log t unchanged.

name: Route K: moments see zeros only in integrated form
statement: I(T)=int_0^T log|zeta(1/2+it)|dt: I(500)=-0.134 (O(1)) while the Jensen-from-moments bound J_1=378.94 grows like T; loss ratio 141 at T=200, 2828 at T=500.

name: Route I: pole-free Weil positivity as Toeplitz positivity T_a[sigma_2]>=0
statement: sigma_2=(t^2+1/4)^2 w_1; lambda_min(T_a[sigma_2])>0 certified for 2a<=0.96 and Arb-certified for all 2a<=ln 3; soft zero crossing near 2a*=1.1316. Fejer-Riesz factorisation gives margin equal to c_sharp itself. Half-pole-free sigma_1 at (ln3)/2: positive (~2e-4).

name: Route I: D_S<=L_S not closable by finitely many constraints
statement: The p=2 resonance window I_1=(8.145,9.875) is the binding direction; two vanishing moments give margin m(2)>=0.539 on [0.30,(ln3)/2] but a finite constraint count only reduces to a k-dimensional low-moment corner with residual 2.8e-3. Pole-inclusive port restores a PSD rank-2 pole form.

name: Route I: {inf,2,3} lacunary relations force g(v)=C/v
statement: Composing g(v)=2g(2v) and g(v)=3g(3v) over the tail interior gives g(v)=2^a3^b g(2^a3^b v) for all (a,b) in Z^2; density of 2^a3^b forces the single profile g(v)=C/v (partial result toward no modulus-1 eigenvalue for the mixed prolate ladder).

name: Three-prime S-unit count approaches (ln U)^3/(6 ln2 ln3 ln5) slowly
statement: count(2^a3^b5^c<=U)/leading = 2.49, 1.90, 1.64, 1.41, 1.26 at U=1e2..1e9, extended to 1e15 with a (ln U)^2 surface correction; primitive-residue slope is exactly 1 per prime-content class with intercept ln(class Euler factor).

name: Route L: off-line detector reach is the Christoffel function saturation
statement: For the atomic measure nu_a, the CMV/Verblunsky Christoffel function lambda_N(theta_k)=1/K_N saturates at the atom mass exactly when the Route L detector first fires; this is the analytic reach law for detection order versus height.

name: de Bruijn flow as viscous Burgers fluid with critical point Lambda
statement: Cole-Hopf with heat potential H_t (nu=1/4 in ordinates, 1/N Dyson); a complex zero pair is a viscous shock with Delta*b=4nu exactly; order parameter phi with RH iff phi(0)=0; equation of state phi=Psi_beta(|t|/tau_*(T)) with exponent (beta+1)/2.

name: Number-variance saturation scale L_sat(T)=log(T/2pi)/(2pi log 2)
statement: From the explicit-formula density fluctuation the number variance over L levels saturates at L_sat set by the prime 2; compared with empirical Sigma_2 on three height cuts of the zero table; explains the gap between real-zero statistics and GUE at finite height.

name: Running minimum gap exponent of zeros versus GUE N^{-1/3}
statement: g_min/y_N on a 14-rung ladder: fitted exponent -0.3953 against the GUE value -1/3; two-term model A N^{-1/3}(1+c/log N) tested; difference assessed as finite-N/plateau bias.

name: Conditional flow-descent theorem B1 (mirror descent), residuals (a),(b)
statement: Proved modulo residuals. Lower edge transfers: the P15 barrier is a rectangle winding count constant in t. Hard half: localisation keeping topmost nonreal zeros at x>=X+1, i.e. a uniform-in-t, all-x lower bound M>=p_req=4.37426 on the mirror pull at y0=0.165 for t in (0,0.1314].

name: Euler-product bound at t=0 does not transport along the de Bruijn flow
statement: H_t for t>0 has no Euler product; a lower bound anchored at t=0 does not extend by flow continuity to the continuum t in (0,t0] (NS-RIGID wall). Same content as the coefficient cocycle 2t log m log n being identical for zeta and DH.

name: Certified lower bound for c_sharp=lambda_min(P_a M_sigma2 P_a) at 2a=ln 3
